rows.label: Chimera Prologue
rows.note: triggered by investigating your quarters on the Orbiter

conditions: MR10 is required to build and equip Paracesis.
bonuses: The blueprint drops into your Foundry for free, no RNG, and unlocks the Ropalolyst fight.

disclosures.title: Shedu is a separate weapon
disclosures.body: Stale threads claim Paracesis is required for story progression or for the Shedu. Both are outdated: the Erra trigger moved off Paracesis in Update 27.2 (2020), and The New War hands you a temporary unranked, unmoddable one at the relevant moment.

groups.activity: crack Void Relics and sell Prime parts to Baro Ki'Teer's Ducat kiosk

rows.label: Orokin Ducats
rows.note: sell Prime parts at the kiosk

alt.text: or Prime Resurgence, at 5 Ducats per Aya

conditions: Baro's Ducat kiosk is always available in relays; it is not gated by his two-week visit schedule.

Capture fissures crack relics fastest, with Void Cascade named as the actual fastest with a competent squad. Avoid Excavation fissures — teammates dropping power cells before anyone has reactant is the near-universal complaint.
bonuses: The Ducanator on warframe.market ranks Prime parts by Ducat-per-platinum. Many 45-Ducat parts sell for 1-2 plat, so buying junk parts outright can be faster than farming them.

disclosures.title: don't buy Ducats with Aya
disclosures.body: Prime Resurgence converts Aya to Ducats at 5:1, called an ungodly rate by the community. Crack relics instead.

groups.activity: kill or capture Eidolon Teralysts at night

rows.label: Eidolon Shard
rows.note: Teralyst 1, Gantulyst 3, Hydrolyst 5 — kill or capture, drop is identical

conditions: Requires The War Within and an Amp from The Quills. The first two Amp ranks need only Vomvalysts zapped and Sentient Cores handed in, no Eidolon kill required.
You only need one charged Eidolon Lure — three Vomvalysts charge it, and a charged lure stops the Teralyst teleporting away between Synovia kills.
bonuses: Skip Gantulyst and Hydrolyst entirely if you only want shards: about seven solo Teralyst resets in one night cycle covers the requirement.
A Sirocco amp with Madurai focus is a serviceable solo option now; Volt is no longer required, just bring a frame that can heal the lures.

disclosures.title: the real wall is the amp
disclosures.body: A Mote Amp with no focus investment is a genuine wall — expect to drain the Teralyst's shields repeatedly while Vomvalysts refresh them until sunrise. Kill Vomvalysts into your lures, not just for their own sake.

disclosures.title: solo beats public
disclosures.body: Eidolon hunting in public matchmaking is the buggiest mode in the game by community consensus — host migration routinely breaks Teralyst spawns and lure state.

rows.label: Galatine
rows.note: Market blueprint 25,000 cr; build 30,000 cr, 4 Gallium, 750 Salvage, 500 Rubedo, 200 Alloy Plate

rows.label: Paracesis
rows.note: 30,000 cr, 1,000 Ducats, 1 Galatine, 5 Eidolon Shards, 15 Orokin Cells

conditions: Galatine must be a finished weapon sitting in your inventory — Forma, Orokin Catalyst, Exilus adapter and Focus lens do not carry over. Install nothing on it, and rank it to 30 first if you want its mastery.
bonuses: Rank 40 (5 Forma) adds Sentient bonus damage up to +60% plus Void damage and resistance-strip properties, worth 4,000 extra mastery on top of the normal 6,000.
